axes.design_axes: f forward (= -x), l left (= +z), u up (= +y)
axes.fg_axes: FG model frame: x aft(+), y right(+), z up(+); AC3D->FG: x->x, y->z, z->-y (wiki Howto:3D Aircraft Models)
axes.model_file_axes: AC3Db as stored: +x aft, +y up, +z left; model front = -x
axes.placement_heading: manifest heading_deg = intended true bearing clockwise from north; stg_heading_deg = value written to the STG (counter-clockwise from north per Docs/README.scenery); runtime sign NOT verified

budget.note: arena-only working budget (no cockpit); large margin kept below the limit

elevation_definition.pose_datums: every pose altitude carries an explicit datum: design_agl_above_anchor_m (meters) or msl_feet (FG --altitude); AGL and MSL are never mixed
elevation_definition.stg_elevation_field: STG entries are OBJECT_STATIC_AGL: the offset field carries meters ABOVE GROUND LEVEL at the anchor and is written 0.0 for every placement, so each model origin sits on the terrain/water surface. 0.0 here is an AGL offset choice, NOT an MSL elevation: terrain MSL at the anchors was never measured in this environment; after a FG/UFO measurement the package can switch to exact-MSL OBJECT_STATIC entries

terrain_height_band_m.source: coastal-terrace design band; no FG install and no elevation service reachable in this build environment

keepouts.note: larger zone: the hangar frame + carrier group

launch.note: list the arena directory before the stock Scenery directory; FG loads terrain from the first path that has it and merges object tiles visited on the way (README.scenery); semantics NOT re-verified on 2024.1.7 here

alt.meaning: meters above the design terrain plane at the rebel anchor (deck top +6.0 m + CG allowance); FG spawn altitude in MSL = unknown terrain height + this

poses.note: future sa_xwing spawn over the rebel pad; deck support NOT verified - until a physical FG test use the fallback poses
future sa_tie spawn over the empire pad, carrier bow ahead at 250 deg; deck support NOT verified
fallback 1: stock KSFO ramp start; identical to the unchanged tools/launch.py default; works with or without the arena
fallback 2: KSFO runway 28R (launcher default runway); the runway heading comes from FGData, not restated here

fallback 3: external air-start over the bay for the c172p visual/scale check, 2500 ft MSL (FG --altitude datum); keeps terrain clearance while FG terrain is below ~2000 ft AGL (terrain NOT verified here); fly east toward the bases, then land back at KSFO

provenance.author: TASK4 subagent (Bombable team)
provenance.external_assets: none - no textures, no binaries, no extracted or third-party game content
provenance.original_geometry_source: src/generate_package.py (the script is the authored original; .ac/.xml/.stg files are committed deterministic artifacts and are never hand-edited)

region.district: Half Moon Bay coastal plain, one tile district ~20 km south of KSFO, entirely inside the default scenery tile w123n37; no stock airport inside the site box

reference_points_not_from_fgdata.note: approximate ARPs from general knowledge; used only for conservative separation reasoning

tile.bucket_note: for negative longitudes SimGear floors lon/10 downward, so tile w123n37 lives in bucket w130n30 (FGData release/2024.1 Docs/README.scenery shows the same bucket for KSFO)

routes.note: straight exit west-southwest over the open coastal plain to the Pacific; clear of the empire base and of KSFO
parallel exit west-southwest ~1.7 km south of the rebel route; static separation of the two corridors is checked by tools/test_space_arena.py

screenshots: scenery/space_arena/screenshots/ (directory is created by the first host-side FG acceptance run; no images are committed because nothing has been rendered yet)

stack_pairs.reason: the static carrier fragment stands inside the static hangar frame envelope on its own ground pylons; the AABB nesting is intentional and the meshes keep clearance (bow points west out of the open front); both are decoration, support/collision was never tested against FG

status_banner: GREYBOX FIRST INCREMENT - NOT runtime-verified; FlightGear 2024.1.7 is absent on this host. See README.md and VALIDATION.md.

stg.agl_note: the offset is meters above ground level at the anchor, written 0.0 because terrain MSL at the anchors is unmeasured; NOT runtime-verified
stg.heading_note: written heading is counter-clockwise degrees from north per Docs/README.scenery
stg.path_base: model paths are relative to the tile directory containing the STG (per $FG_ROOT/Docs/README.scenery)

surfaces.note: FG gives static scenery models no landing support by default; no scenery material override is configured; do NOT treat this as a supported surface until a physical FG test
the natural terrain under the pads is the surface to verify first in FG before any deck test

units: meters for all lengths; WGS84 decimal degrees for lon/lat (west/south negative); degrees for angles; knots for airspeeds

verification.collision: NOT VERIFIED - no physical test was possible
verification.fg_runtime_load: NOT VERIFIED - FlightGear 2024.1.7 is not installed on this host
verification.launcher_compatibility: the stock tools/launch.py defaults (c172p, KSFO, 28R) are untouched; the arena is an ADDITIONAL --fg-scenery path only (design compatibility, not runtime-proven)
verification.static_package: python3 -m unittest tools/test_space_arena.py (JSON/XML/AC3Db structure, ids, WGS84 and elevation/heading conventions, bucket, triangle budget, clearance invariants, sha256 + determinism)
verification.support_surfaces: NOT VERIFIED - both decks are marked experimental
verification.visual: NOT VERIFIED - nothing was ever rendered; no screenshots exist
